aiReviewer: GPT-6 (AI editorial review; no human review)
reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial pass over 30 original low-typing questions: checked complete German sentences, four offered choices, morphology, intended meaning, accepted answers, bilingual hints and explanations and distinct contexts. Fifteen sources authored, five deferred for obsolete banking identifiers, regional register, rare birdcage sense and questionable B2 level. Corrected Bart gender, Batterie gloss, Bargeld plurality, Bauabnahme and Bauherr semantics. No independent human approval, CEFR certification or rights clearance. All target reviews pending; publicationApproved=false. Follow-up AI editorial corrections removed a defensible Folge distractor and clarified the bridge and application-processing contexts.
